primaryVisualEvidence.description: Released gameplay uploaded by independent player Spazbo4. All archived PNGs are native 640 × 480 decoded frames or explicit crops. Their sample times identify playback time in the public 3632.799-second recording.

profiles.stage: Toluca Prison, imprisoned worm pursuit in Stage 2-1, before the separate Stage 2-2 Split Worm encounter.

frontalEvidence.sourceType: Unmodified decoded released arcade gameplay from player Spazbo4; public H.264 Archive.org longplay.
frontalEvidence.note: Native gameplay frame; the complete projected silhouette is surrounded by corridor backdrop. The near-end mouth is open, and the extended body is occluded by the front section along the viewing axis.

frontalEvidence.note: Foreshortened near-frontal silhouette with paired dorsal folds, a median groove and rounded lower perimeter. Marks from gameplay effects across the mouth do not belong to its anatomy.

frontalEvidence.sourceType: Unmodified decoded released arcade gameplay from player Spazbo4; public H.264 Archive.org longplay.
frontalEvidence.note: Fresh adjacent banked turn; halo of corridor visible on all sides of the complete projected mass. Slight leading turn shows ridged flank.

lateralEvidence.finding: The camera turns into the adjoining cell. Its side-on view shows an intermediate embroidered-looking fold passing across the doorway. The mouth and rear continuation are out of sight.

profiles.inspection: Wide survey every 20 s from 12:00 to 36:40; one-second survey from 25:03 to 25:53; selected full-resolution frames. Foreground motion and the adjoining-cell flank were checked in closer samples from 25:43.4 to 25:46.9 and 25:49.8 to 25:54.8.
profiles.selection: The face projects ahead of the extended trunk. At 25:27 the real outer edge of the worm as seen from the front is surrounded by visible background. The source arcade cutout keeps the paired upper folds, circular lower mouth and rounded bulges of this projected silhouette. This neither establishes nor depicts the end of the trunk.
profiles.sideDecision: Unresolved. Banked views show the flank around the mouth, but the visible body still overlaps its own continuation almost along the viewing axis. The true side-on doorway pass shows only a midsection, without the head or rear. Neither camera angle yields a whole independently grounded lateral pose.

evidence.finding: The upper cap and cascading locks enter the shot between the protagonists. The lower transition into the lake is masked and exits the picture.
The central facial opening and hand are distinct. The hair and submerged junction are outside the picture.
The face has already gone down. Water spray masks the lower structure and the arm leaves the frame above.

profiles.inspection: Previous wide-stage and half-second capture dossier independently checked against native release footage. New onset samples 54:14.85–54:16.95 every 0.10 s; defeat samples 55:18.2–55:27 every 0.26 s.
profiles.finding: The earlier calm appearance shows the central head, with the lower hair or water junction concealed. Once the entire central head rises and the arm emerges, several strands run beyond the left, upper and right frame edges. During submergence the face goes underwater first and the arm separates visually; its upper section crosses the top before a single clean outline can be recovered. An arm-only sprite would identify a different manifestation.
profiles.decision: No new Phantom output or independent side view. Submerged legs are irrelevant to the blocker; missing boundaries involve the visible protruding locks and arm.

archivesExcluded: The coiled SH4 render, the separate Arcade Split Worm and the isolated Hand of Phantom were not used to invent geometry. No historic refusals retried.
